'''Getting started''' with ''Star Wars'' CCG takes two 60-card decks, one [[Side|Light Side]] and one Dark Side, and a little table space. No tokens or counters are needed: the cards themselves keep score, with 1 card equal to 1 unit of Force.<ref name="rb20">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/serules.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Rulebook, Version 2.0], Decipher (November 1998). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20081221001241/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/serules.pdf Internet Archive]. Wiki transcription: [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game RULEBOOK 2.0]]</ref>

== Learn the rules ==
* [[How to play]] – short overview.
* [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game RULEBOOK 2.0]] – Decipher's 1998 rulebook, written to teach the basic procedures. Decipher's [[Decipher Glossary 2.0]] is the comprehensive companion.<ref name="rb20" />
* [[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook]] – the current tournament rules; see [[Rules]] and [[Rulebooks]] for the full library.

== Set up a game ==
# Each player secretly chooses a starting location from their deck. Both are revealed and placed with each half facing its side.<ref name="rb20" />
# Each player shuffles the rest of the deck face down as the Reserve Deck and draws 8 cards.<ref name="rb20" />
# The Dark Side player takes the first turn. Each turn has six [[Phase|phases]]: activate, control, deploy, battle, move and draw.<ref name="rb20" />
# Deplete the opponent's [[Life Force]] (Reserve Deck, Force Pile and Used Pile) to win.<ref name="rb20" />

== Get cards ==
Decipher sold preconstructed [[Starter Decks]] and two-player introductory games alongside booster packs. Players now also build decks with Players Committee [[V-slips|virtual cards]] or play online.

== Play online ==
[[GEMP]] runs the game in a browser at [https://play.swccg.com/ play.swccg.com]. Organized play formats are listed on [[Formats]], and events on [[Tournaments]].
